name: Davinder Singh (lawyer)
profileSummary: Davinder Singh Sachdev is a Singaporean lawyer and former politician. A former member of the governing People's Action Party (PAP), he was the Member of Parliament (MP) representing the Toa Payoh division of Toa Payoh Group Representation Constituency (GRC) between 1988 and 1991 and the Toa Payoh East division of Bishan–Toa Payoh GRC between 1997 and 2006.
